spec: No human data touched. Synthetic within-cohort tick 3 assessment. B6* is defined as representationally saturated conditional history class, cannot be estimated on sparse simulated histories with same budget.

A.question: Build genuine shared pre-outcome event panels with a time-based within-cohort split and audit no future outcomes
A.estimand: synthetic prospective per-exposure unilateral proposal probability

B.null: SRM and flexible history model do not improve baseline B2 under equal training and features
B.prior_art: SRM and B6* well established; not new sociological discovery

C.endpoint: 24x4 synthetic; seeds 12000-12049; ticks0-2 fitting, tick3 evaluation; each exposure unique event, labels and identities conservation, no observed outcome in features
C.falsification: any row imbalance, actor leakage, split misuse -> INVALID; B2 equal/better undermines incremental ESRM advantage

D.model_params: L2 fixed C=0.3, all 9 pre-outcome covariates; boosting 100 iterations shallow leaves and min leaf 20
D.source_code_SHA: freeze later in separate GitHub commit before outcomes

F.adversarial: same rows/features/budget; compare label sham and no ID info; avoid source-truth asymmetry
F.negative_controls: renamed/shuffled actor IDs and withheld tick

G.holdout: SYNTHETIC tick3 fixed; no external replication

H.priors: No human posterior change without independent data
